final: WITH g AS (SELECT eventannotm AS timing, AVG(instownpct) AS gavg FROM sentimentandfundamentals WHERE eventannotm IS NOT NULL AND instownpct IS NOT NULL GROUP BY eventannotm), o AS (SELECT AVG(gavg) AS oavg FROM g WHERE gavg IS NOT NULL), p AS (SELECT g.timing, g.gavg, o.oavg, g.gavg - o.oavg AS diff FROM g JOIN o ON o.oavg IS NOT NULL WHERE g.gavg > o.oavg) SELECT AVG(gavg) AS avg_group_avg, AVG(diff) AS avg_diff FROM p
